'''Uwin Lokk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was a [[weaponsmith]] with a shop in the [[Senate Commercial District]] where he taught his trade.
